chunks.sanskrit: yadī̍gͫ śṛ̠ṇotya̠laka̍gͫ śṛṇoti na hi pra̠veda̍ sukṛ̠tasya̠ panthā̠miti̍|
saptakarṇa̍śca plā̠khṣiḥ ānuśravika eva nau kaśya̍pa i̠ti|
sa̠pta diśo̠ nānā̍ sūryāḥ sa̠pta hotā̍ra ṛ̠tvijaḥ̍|
yaddyāva̍ indra te śa̠tagͫ śa̠taṃ bhūmīḥ̎|
na tvā̍ vajrinthsa̠hasra̠g̠ͫ sūryāḥ̎ anu na jātamaṣṭa roda̍sī i̠ti|
viṣu̍rūpe̠ aha̍nī̠ dyauri̍va sthaḥ viśvā̠ hi mā̠yā ava̍thassvadhāvantau|
tayo̍ re̠tau va̠thsau u̠ṣmā ca̍ nīhā̠raśca̍|
asa̍taḥ sa̠dye tata̍khṣuḥ ṛṣa̍yaḥ sa̠ptātri̍śca̠ yat|
a̠mī ya ṛkhṣā̠ nihi̍tā sa u̠ccā|
bhargo̍ de̠vasya̍ dhīmahi dhiyo̠ yo naḥ̍ praco̠dayā̎t|

na̠ ri̠ṣyati̍ na vya̠thate nā̠syākhṣo̍ yātu̠ sajja̍ti|
ito rudrāḥ̎ parā̠ṅgatāḥ uktagͫͫ sthānaṃ pramāṇañca̍ pura̠ ita||
